about: Worker E, problem 5 (flat-black surfaces), approved by the coordinator Nov 16: three extra launches at con_boiler after its Remix run and no-Remix reference. One rtx.conf change each against the play-setup baseline. albedo: Remix's primary albedo debug view. direct_diffuse: demodulated (divided by albedo) noisy primary direct diffuse radiance, so it shows light reaching the surface whatever its albedo. no_mod_materials: the mod's replacement materials off, game materials only.
